picks.title: Factory hits $1.5B valuation to build AI coding for enterprises
picks.why_it_matters: A 3-year-old startup reaching unicorn status with Khosla leading signals continued strong appetite for AI dev tools and validates the enterprise AI coding market as a category worth watching at earlier stages.

picks.title: Slash, a Ramp competitor founded by teenagers, raises $100M at $1.4B valuation
picks.why_it_matters: Demonstrates fintech spend management still has room for new entrants, and $300M ARR proof point shows younger founders can scale B2B companies—a signal to take non-traditional founder profiles seriously.

picks.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: Agentic coding power, now open to all
picks.why_it_matters: High-performing open-weight models reaching developer zeitgeist (1000+ HN score) accelerates the commoditization of foundational AI, creating opportunities for startups building differentiated applications and tooling layers on top.
